text:
sara: Quick preflight check for QuietField private deployment — locking down last networking owners. Target cutover Thu EOD. Need final owners for NAT, image sync, and cert pinning.

linus: I'll own NAT + egress rules. I'll validate SNAT and NAT gateway failover tomorrow morning. ping me for CIDR lists. :white_check_mark:

rahul: Image-sync update: registry -> airgapped bucket pipeline hit a checksum mismatch on r-encoder:1.2.3-rc. I can re-push if we decide to. Command I ran: `skopeo copy docker://registry/quietfield/r-encoder:1.2.3-rc dir:/tmp/images`

tess: Can we avoid a full re-push? We have the offline hash mirror script. Suggest running `./tools/hash-verify.sh /tmp/images` first to confirm the mismatch isn't from transfer. Example:```bash
# locally
./tools/hash-verify.sh /tmp/images
# returns non-zero if mismatch
```

deploy-bot: airgap-sync-job/quietfield: finished uploading 3 images to s3://quietfield-airgap/. logs: https://ci.redwood/airgap/1234 :white_check_mark:

david: Cert pinning question: customer wants to pin the CA chain fingerprint. We support pinning via vault-managed CA refs but need to confirm rotation plan. Current idea: pass `tls.ca_sha256` into the deploy config and fetch intermediate certs from Vault on boot. e.g. `tls: { ca_sha256: "AB:CD:EF:..." }`

amy-pm: Also need owners for rollback runbook and canary metrics definition. Who's on-call for SLO pages and can provide the alert thresholds?

linus: I'll draft rollback steps (iptables NAT flush, route cleanup, switch to hosted fallback). I'll add the sequence and runbook playbook to the rollout board by EOD.

rahul: I re-signed r-encoder and uploaded a signed tarball to s3://quietfield-airgap/. Quick check: `s3cmd ls s3://quietfield-airgap/ | grep r-encoder` -> sample output:
`2026-06-01 12:02  12873456  r-encoder-1.2.3-rc.tgz`

sara: Thanks all. Action items: @linus NAT owner; @rahul image sync + verify; @david tls pin handoff; @tess run hash-verify in the CI airgap job; @amy-pm provide canary metrics list. I'll update the rollout board and ping security for cert rotation signoff. If anyone hits NIC/kernel driver issues during image smoking, tag #eng-infra. :rocket:
